visual.description: Side-by-side comparison on dark bg. Left panel: South Korea flag + 'GDP: $1.67T' + 'Work hours: 1,872 hrs/yr'. Right panel: Japan flag + 'Work hours: 1,626 hrs/yr'. A connecting line shows '+246 hrs/yr' gap in #E06070. Below: estimated loss bar for South Korea: '$31B–$49B/year' in #D47FA6 with prominent on-screen label: '⚠️ ESTIMATED — Not a RAND-measured figure. Modelled using Japan\'s GDP loss ratio applied to South Korean GDP.' Source: OECD Annual Hours Worked, World Bank GDP 2022.

notes: ⚠️ ESTIMATED label REQUIRED on screen — this is NOT a RAND-measured figure. Modelled using Japan's GDP loss ratio. Production flag #2.
